scope: Fresh web form steps, simpler lists, and faster key response.

topics.title: Type when you reach a text box
details: Use Up or Down to reach a text box. You can start typing at once, just as you can after Tab. Escape leaves editing. Passwords stay hidden.

topics.title: Read the current form step
details: When a site moves from an email box to a password box, the page view updates. Hidden old boxes no longer stay active. Page checks also run while the microphone listens.

topics.title: Hear simple names in page lists
details: The links list reads each link name in the page’s Tab order. The headings list reads each name followed by its level number. Type a name to find it.

topics.title: Move through pages with less waiting
details: Page checks use less repeated work. A fresh page view replaces old text even when an earlier cursor update is still waiting. Keyboard input still stops old speech.
